description: The Weekly Maps table: for each of the 5 maps every live lineup with its record, confidence score, map score and whether it has enough battles to win the map, plus the overall weekly totals. Each map also names mostPoints (the main lineup with the highest mapScore so far this week, which is what wins the map) and inTheLead (the main lineup with the highest confidence right now, which may be catching up). Pass week (a past week id from past_weeks) for a finished week's final results.

week.description: Optional past week id, like "2026-11-08". Leave out for this week.

name: weekly_standings
